meta.title: Backend Mastery — 45-Day Expedition
meta.description: A curated 45-day path from React Native developer to production-capable backend engineer: Node/Express fundamentals, PostgreSQL + Supabase, five hands-on projects, NestJS, a real production codebase, DevOps, AWS, and system design. One module per day at 1–2 hrs/day; side quests are optional extras that never block the path.

phases.title: Foundations
phases.tagline: The backend mental model — from fetch() to a layered server

modules.title: The journey of a request
modules.summary: What actually happens when your RN app calls fetch() — DNS, TLS, the server, and the response, told as a story you can debug.

modules.title: HTTP: the contract language
modules.summary: Methods, status codes, headers, idempotency — why PUT twice is fine but POST twice double-charges.

modules.title: Your first server
modules.summary: Node + Express hello API: routes, path params, JSON in/out. The moment the other side of fetch() stops being magic.

modules.title: The middleware pipeline
modules.summary: Auth, logging, and error handling as an assembly line — and why the order of the line changes everything.

modules.title: Guard the boundary: validation, env, logs
modules.summary: Zod as the bouncer at the door, env validation at startup, structured logging with pino — the three habits that make code production-grade before it's clever.

modules.title: Layering + the Notes API
modules.summary: route → service → data. Build a layered Notes API with soft delete and honest 404s. First checkpoint.

phases.title: The Data Layer
phases.tagline: SQL, PostgreSQL, and what Supabase actually is

modules.title: SQL crash course I: tables & CRUD
modules.summary: Tables, types, constraints, and the four verbs — designed so you stop translating SQL in your head.

modules.title: SQL crash course II: joins & shapes
modules.summary: 1:N, M:N, join types, aggregations — every relationship your app's screens already imply.

modules.title: Indexes & transactions
modules.summary: The B-tree mental model, EXPLAIN 101, ACID, and when Postgres locks — why one missing index makes a screen take 4 seconds.

modules.title: Supabase 101
modules.summary: What's actually running behind that dashboard — Postgres, Auth, Realtime, Storage — plus project setup and the migrations concept.

phases.title: Project 1: Task Manager
phases.tagline: Your first real API — auth, schema, RLS, services

modules.title: Build: scaffold, env, auth
modules.summary: Scaffold the Task Manager API: env validation, pino, and Supabase JWT auth middleware — a real login your RN app could use.

modules.title: Build: schema, migrations, triggers
modules.summary: Design tasks + categories tables, write versioned migrations, add an updated_at trigger and the indexes your queries need.

modules.title: Build: RLS — rows that don't exist
modules.summary: Row-level security for own-data access — including the deliberate manual-WHERE-clause trap that shows why 'remember the WHERE' is not a security model.

modules.title: Build: services, filters, ship it
modules.summary: Service layer, dynamic query filters, and the verification checklist. Checkpoint: explain any line cold.

phases.title: Real-time, Jobs & Files
phases.tagline: The concepts behind every chat screen, upload, and background task

modules.title: Cursor pagination
modules.summary: Why offset pagination breaks infinite scroll (you've seen the duplicated feed items) and how cursors fix it.

modules.title: WebSockets & Supabase Realtime
modules.summary: How a message reaches every device in under a second — build the chat core with REST + WS together.

modules.title: Presence, typing & rate limits
modules.summary: Online status, typing indicators, multi-device tracking — persistent vs ephemeral state — plus token-bucket rate limiting.

modules.title: Background jobs: BullMQ + Redis
modules.summary: Slow work leaves the request path. Run a worker as a separate process and hit the two silent-job-loss traps on purpose.

modules.title: The file pipeline
modules.summary: Multer → Supabase Storage → signed URLs → sharp thumbnails in a job. The exact pipeline behind every avatar upload.

modules.title: Postgres power tools
modules.summary: Recursive CTEs (folder trees), JSONB (flexible metadata), materialized views (pre-computed stats). Checkpoint.

phases.title: Production Data Patterns
phases.tagline: Money, search, caching, RBAC — plus API design & security done right

modules.title: Money & transactions
modules.summary: Prices in cents, atomic order creation, SELECT FOR UPDATE — why two buyers can't both get the last item.

modules.title: Full-text search
modules.summary: tsvector, GIN indexes, weighted ranking — how search bars actually work without an external service.

modules.title: Caching with Redis
modules.summary: Cache-aside, TTLs, and the two hard problems — including the stale-data bug you will absolutely ship once.

modules.title: Query performance
modules.summary: EXPLAIN ANALYZE, partial indexes, denormalization tradeoffs — finding the slow query before your users do.

modules.title: RBAC & multi-tenancy
modules.summary: Role hierarchies, middleware factories, org-scoped RLS — how one database safely serves many teams.

modules.title: API design that lasts
modules.summary: Resource naming, versioning, pagination conventions, error shapes, webhooks — the roadmap.sh api-design track distilled for someone who consumes APIs daily.

modules.title: API security essentials
modules.summary: OWASP API Top 10, broken authorization (the #1 real-world hole), secrets handling, rate limiting. Checkpoint.

phases.title: NestJS: The Framework Layer
phases.tagline: The opinionated framework your other backend runs on — DI, modules, guards, DTOs

modules.title: NestJS: the framework with opinions
modules.summary: Dependency injection, modules, controllers, providers — why big teams trade Express's freedom for Nest's structure. Port a slice of your Task Manager and feel the difference.

modules.title: NestJS in production
modules.summary: DTOs + ValidationPipe, guards vs middleware, interceptors, exception filters, ConfigModule, testing — the patterns your own CLAUDE.md rules already demand, now from the inside.

phases.title: The Real Codebase
phases.tagline: The work codebase: Bun, Hono, Drizzle, RLS pools, twin queues — and your first PRs

modules.title: New stack, same ideas
modules.summary: Bun vs Node, Hono vs Express, Drizzle vs supabase-js — a translation table for everything you just learned.

modules.title: Repo orientation & route trace
modules.summary: Run the work backend locally, read its ARCHITECTURE doc, and hand-trace one route → service → Drizzle query → response schema.

modules.title: The two DB pools
modules.summary: Request-scoped c.get("db") vs the privileged pool — the single most expensive distinction in the codebase, and what 'bypasses RLS' means for real user data.

modules.title: Twin job queues
modules.summary: Two pg-boss instances on separate schemas. Enqueue on the wrong one and watch a job silently never run.

modules.title: Append-only migrations
modules.summary: Why a migration file is a historical fact, not a draft — hand-edit one in a sandbox and watch two databases diverge.

modules.title: Contracts with your own app
modules.summary: zod-openapi route schemas, the silent-rename trap, and additive evolution — you ARE the mobile client that breaks.

modules.title: Ship PR 1, start PR 2
modules.summary: A low-stakes cleanup PR to learn the pipeline, then begin a real feature with a migration, an RLS policy, and a service. Spilling into extra evenings is expected.

phases.title: DevOps & AWS
phases.tagline: Docker, CI/CD, observability, incident response — and the AWS you actually need

modules.title: Docker
modules.summary: Images vs containers, Dockerfile for your API, compose with Postgres + Redis — plus why containers make graceful shutdown matter.

modules.title: CI/CD & the release train
modules.summary: GitHub Actions pipelines (lint/type/test on PR), environments, dev → main flow, migrations in CI, Railway — and why on your team merging to main IS the production deploy.

modules.title: Observability
modules.summary: Sentry, PostHog, log levels, alerts — how you find out something broke before users tweet about it.

modules.title: AWS core
modules.summary: IAM (least privilege), S3 + presigned URLs, EC2 vs managed services, RDS vs Supabase — with billing guardrails first.

modules.title: AWS async & edge
modules.summary: Lambda + API Gateway, SQS vs the queues you know, CloudFront/Route53/ACM — the delivery half of AWS.

modules.title: Incident response
modules.summary: Triage flow, rollback strategies, postmortems without blame — operating like the tech lead you're becoming. Checkpoint.

phases.title: System Design & Mastery
phases.tagline: Design the systems you've been building — then prove it all

modules.title: The system design toolkit
modules.summary: Back-of-envelope estimation, caching layers, replicas, sharding, idempotency keys — the vocabulary of scale.

modules.title: Design the feed (and the chat)
modules.summary: A social app's actual hard problems: fan-out on write vs read, feed warmup jobs, unread counts — then chat + presence at scale.

modules.title: Mastery checkpoint
modules.summary: Kick off PR 3 (a real security-hardening fix your mentor hands you), answer the final oral checkpoint cold, and map where you go next.

sideQuests.title: TypeScript sharpening for backend
sideQuests.summary: Generics, unknown-narrowing, discriminated unions — the TS you skip in RN but need for service code.

sideQuests.title: Schema design drills
sideQuests.summary: Normalization deep dive plus three schema-review exercises with intentionally flawed designs to critique.

sideQuests.title: Complete the Chat API
sideQuests.summary: Finish chat-app-api end-to-end: LATERAL joins, stored functions, UPSERT, full verification checklist.

sideQuests.title: Complete the File Vault
sideQuests.summary: Finish file-vault-api: permission hierarchy, polymorphic associations with CHECK, storage usage views.

sideQuests.title: Stripe payments end-to-end
sideQuests.summary: PaymentIntents, webhook signature verification, raw body handling — the full marketplace payment flow.

sideQuests.title: Event sourcing & state machines
sideQuests.summary: Order events as the source of truth and enforced status transitions — marketplace-api's most transferable pattern.

sideQuests.title: Complete the Project Tracker
sideQuests.summary: Table partitioning, human-readable issue keys, change tracking, health checks, graceful shutdown — the full production-patterns build.

sideQuests.title: Port the Task Manager to NestJS
sideQuests.summary: Full port: modules, DI, JwtAuthGuard, DTOs with class-validator, exception filters, e2e tests with Jest — then read a real NestJS boilerplate's src/ layout and recognize every pattern.

sideQuests.title: The mentor's full 4-week ramp
sideQuests.summary: Your backend dev's original onboarding doc as a complete track — all deliberate traps, all oral checkpoints.

sideQuests.title: Deploy a project to AWS for real
sideQuests.summary: Take one of your five projects live on EC2 + RDS + S3 (or Fargate) with a domain and TLS.

sideQuests.title: Supabase deep dive
sideQuests.summary: Edge Functions, storage internals, connection pooling with Supavisor, branching workflows.

sideQuests.title: More design exercises
sideQuests.summary: A media pipeline, a push notification system, offline sync for mobile — three guided design workouts.

sideQuests.title: Load testing with k6
sideQuests.summary: Write load tests against your Task Manager API, find its breaking point, and fix the first bottleneck.
